note: User-curated calibration universe (valuation-recalibration-spec §3.1: the UNIVERSE is part of the pre-stated target). The human OWNS this list. The AUTOMATED-fundamentals universe is SEC filers: US 10-K filers (full ~10yr EDGAR XBRL history) plus foreign 20-F/40-F filers (EDGAR IFRS, ~2022+ history). 2026-06-15: expanded to the numbers-free calibration objective list (5 roles spanning the cheapness range so the must-signal/froth windows have something to discriminate) and FDS removed (not a name we'd own; its old-method 8.2% CAGR no longer anchors the growth cap). Roles: A never-cheap compounders (GOOGL/MSFT/AAPL/COST/CPRT), B duopoly/regulated-info (MCO/SPGI/MA; V deferred — multi-class shares expose no flat diluted-share concept), C mature/ex-growth (PG/KO/PEP/CLX), D cyclical moats (NKE canary/LIN), E live moat-eroders (ADBE/CRM/WDAY — the correct-DECLINE test; the moat-direction cross-check is Phase 7). Names with no automated primary source (non-SEC filers on DFM/ADX) are marked status:'deferred' with a reason — listed for transparency but skipped, NEVER 'needs manual entry'. Edit this file to add/remove names; `version` is bumped on every change and a calibration_run records WHICH version it used for reproducibility.
